newsitem.title: USA: April Brent steps up in thin late U.S. activity.
newsitem.headline: April Brent steps up in thin late U.S. activity.

text.p: North Sea Brent stepped up in thin late U.S. activity Tuesday, with many traders occupied at annual IP week festivities in London, traders said.
Partial paper April Brent cargoes changed hands 200 times at $20.46 a barrel and 100 times at $20.51 a barrel, compared to the IPE settlement of $20.40, traders said.
March/April spreads moved three times at 36 cents and once at 37 cents a barrel, up from 28 cents at the London close.
